Desc.SourceString: 呜哇，烫烫烫——但是好好吃！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooow, it's ho-ho-hot! But it's so good!

Desc.SourceString: 好香啊！不愧是卜多力的招牌！
Desc.LocalizedString: That tasty smell! No wonder it's the house special of Budoriya!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，你也点了这个？看来我们的口味很一致嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you ordered this too? We got similar tastes!

Desc.SourceString: 这个超好吃的，要不要尝尝？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is suuuper good. Wanna try?

Desc.SourceString: 别发呆了，可可，再不吃菜就凉了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, the dish will get cold if you keep staring!

Desc.SourceString: 唔，我是不是吃的有点多了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, did I eat too much?

Desc.SourceString: 同样的东西，和可可一起吃好像更香了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you make food taste so much better!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，干杯——！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, cheers!

Desc.SourceString: 呼啊，好饱好饱——多谢款待，可可，我们下次再来吃，我请你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wah, I'm so full! Thanks, Coco. I'll buy you a meal the next time!

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮转一圈要多久呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: How long does it take for the Ferris wheel to spin once?

Desc.SourceString: 要是带点零食上来就好了！
Desc.LocalizedString: If only we brought some snacks with us!

Desc.SourceString: 啦啦啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hums to herserlf)

Desc.SourceString: 换个角度看海特洛，还挺新奇的嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hethereau is different from this angle. Interesting!

Desc.SourceString: 快看，窗外的云彩很漂亮哦！唔，想吃棉花糖了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Look! The clouds has pretty colors. Ow, I want cotton candy now…

Desc.SourceString: 好美的风景！可可，我们来合张影吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: So beautiful! Coco, let's take a pic together!

Desc.SourceString: 完全没有坐够嘛！可可，下次还要一起玩，就这么说好啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: That wasn't nearly enough! Coco, let's come play together. It's a deal!

Desc.SourceString: 这段剧情真不错！可可也这么觉得吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: This plot is fire! Coco, do you think so too?

Desc.SourceString: 听说片尾还有彩蛋呢，待会儿可别急着走！
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard there's an Easter Egg at the end. Don't leave too fast!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，再走神就要错过精彩片段了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you're about to miss a great scene!

Desc.SourceString: 呼啊，看的好过瘾！之后上映新影片的时候再来一起看吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Uwu, that was fun! Let's come again when there's a new movie!

Desc.SourceString: 吃我一拳！小菜一碟……欸欸等一下，空大了！？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eat this! Piece of cake… Oh wait, I missed!?

Desc.SourceString: 左边！右边！左边！右边！赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Left! Right! Left Right! I win!

Desc.SourceString: 看不起谁呢？！柯林斯家族永不言败！
Desc.LocalizedString: Who do you think I am? The Coluccis never give up!

Desc.SourceString: 要切磋一下吗？我可不会手下留情！
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want to play with me? I won't go easy on you!

Desc.SourceString: 唉，有言道胜败乃兵家常事。更何况，输给我你也不算丢人。下次我让着你点，放心~
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, win some lose some. Besides, losing to me is nothing to be ashamed of. I'll go easy on you next time, I promise.

Desc.SourceString: 不行不行，这把不算。主要是今天没吃饱，输出力度不够！
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no, that doesn't count. I didn't eat enough today. I couldn't pack my punch!

Desc.SourceString: 今天也算是玩了个爽！强者相伴，不虚此行~鉴定师，我们下次再战！
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, I had a lot of fun. It was nice having someone as strong as you. Let's fight again!

Desc.SourceString: 我脸上有东西吗……不会是什么虫子？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there something on my face…? Is it a bug?

Desc.SourceString: 流星雨划过的时候，记得许愿噢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Remember to make a wish when you see a meteor.

Desc.SourceString: 像这样一起荡着秋千，听听虫鸣……好开心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Swinging together like this, listening to the crickets… this is nice.

Desc.SourceString: 果然和鉴定师待在一起，总能看到特别漂亮的风景~嘿嘿。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, I knew I'd see great stuff if I'm with you.

Desc.SourceString: 啦~哒啦~??
Desc.LocalizedString: La~da~la~🎵

Desc.SourceString: 离天空最近的点在哪呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: When is it closest to the sky…?

Desc.SourceString: 里面暖呼呼的……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's warm inside…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你会不会恐高？别担心，有我在！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you afraid of heights? Don't worry, I'm here!

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮和冰淇淋最适配了，一会儿去买一个~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ice cream is great for Ferris wheels! Let's buy some soon?

Desc.SourceString: 绝佳观赏点！一起合影怎么样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Perfect spot! Let's take a pic together!

Desc.SourceString: 突然想到了一件很好的事……暂时保密！下次坐摩天轮的时候告诉你！
Desc.LocalizedString: I just had a great idea… I'll keep it a secret for now. I'll tell you the next time we come here!

Desc.SourceString: 你也觉得这个主角很逊吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You think this MC sucks too?

Desc.SourceString: 看到刚刚那幕了吗？！燃爆了！！
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you see that? That was insane!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉……是不是缺了爆米花和可乐？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are we… missing popcorn and soda?

Desc.SourceString: 这部也还不赖嘛！下次我们再选什么题材看看呢……？
Desc.LocalizedString: That movie wasn't so bad! What should we watch next…?

Desc.SourceString: 若是执行任务，这里会是个不错的观察点。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a good observation spot for a mission.

Desc.SourceString: 风声都被隔绝在外了~
Desc.LocalizedString: There's no wind inside!

Desc.SourceString: 身处高处，向来更容易判断局势。
Desc.LocalizedString: High spots are great for making decisions.

Desc.SourceString: 看来今天的风景，并不只是窗外这一片。
Desc.LocalizedString: Seems like there's more to see that what's outside of the window.

Desc.SourceString: 你看得如此认真，是发现了什么吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You staring so intently. Did you find something?

Desc.SourceString: 我在想接下来的行程……鉴定师，你呢，你想去哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I'm thinking… Where do you want to go next?

Desc.SourceString: 希望下次还有机会和你一同乘坐摩天轮，鉴定师~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I hope I can come here with you for the Ferris wheel again!

Desc.SourceString: 你刚才也注意到了吗？这段内容对观众，未免有些小小的误导~
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you notice that too? I think that could mislead the audience a bit.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？已经有结论了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? You know what's happening next?

Desc.SourceString: 或许这种时候，更需要几分专注。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe it's time to focus a little.

Desc.SourceString: 下次如果有合适的电影，可别忘了叫上我，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, if there's a good movie, don't forget to let me know.

Desc.SourceString: 很平稳呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's steady.

Desc.SourceString: 如果一只鸟不小心撞过来……
Desc.LocalizedString: If a bird flew over here…

Desc.SourceString: 一个浪漫的密闭空间，呵呵~
Desc.LocalizedString: A romantic, confined space. Heh…

Desc.SourceString: 我在看风景……你在看谁~？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm admiring what's outside… And you are?

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮啊。这地方总是出现在情人约会的场所呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, a Ferris wheel. It always becomes a popular dating site.

Desc.SourceString: 或许还能做些有意思的事情……?
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps it's a good place to do something fun…♥

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，一副意犹未尽的表情呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, you look like you want more.

Desc.SourceString: 是谁分心了~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who's not focusing?

Desc.SourceString: 意思是……我比电影好看吗？?
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you mean… I'm more interesting than the movie? ♥

Desc.SourceString: 昏暗的地方，总让人有种危险的暧昧感……你觉得呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Dim places have a dangerous chemistry… don't they?

Desc.SourceString: 这么快就放映结束了……是因为和你在一起，时间过得特别快吗~？
Desc.LocalizedString: It ended that fast? Or was it because… time flies when I'm with you?

Desc.SourceString: 越来越高了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's getting higher…

Desc.SourceString: 应该是……是安全的吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is… safe, right?

Desc.SourceString: 地上的灯像是星星……
Desc.LocalizedString: The lights on the ground look like stars…

Desc.SourceString: 没、没有很害怕，在你身边很安全。
Desc.LocalizedString: I-I'm not afraid. I feel safe around you.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然很、很高，但上面的风景很好呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Although we're h-high up, the view is great.

Desc.SourceString: 从高处看下去，会感觉到……很自由
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking down from here… I feel free…

Desc.SourceString: 重回地面了……下、下次还可以一起。
Desc.LocalizedString: And… we're back down. Let's d-do this again.

Desc.SourceString: 是要……聊聊后面的剧情的吗？但请、请不要剧透。
Desc.LocalizedString: You know wh-what's… happening next? P-Please don't tell me.

Desc.SourceString: 我也很喜欢刚刚那个情节。
Desc.LocalizedString: I liked that scene a lot.

Desc.SourceString: 怎、怎么了吗？难道我、我刚刚叫出声了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wh-What? Did I let out a s-squeak?

Desc.SourceString: 结束了吗？真想再看一场啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: That's it? I want to watch another one…

Desc.SourceString: 世上没有完全相同的两片风景……每分每秒都在变。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are no two movies that are the same… Things change every second.

Desc.SourceString: 我喜欢这旋转的速度，优哉游哉、稳步向前。
Desc.LocalizedString: I like this speed. It's easy and unhurried, spinning steadily.

Desc.SourceString: 在这个角度能看着伊波恩么？唉~地段……地段。
Desc.LocalizedString: Can we see Eibon from here? (Sigh) Locations, locations.

Desc.SourceString: 这样悠闲的时光还真是不赖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Peaceful moments like these are rather nice.

Desc.SourceString: 我的招财宝，你有放松一些了么？
Desc.LocalizedString: My Precious, have you relaxed a bit?

Desc.SourceString: 有没有觉得，摩天轮就像这座城市里最大的时钟？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you think the Ferris wheel is the largest clock in the city?

Desc.SourceString: 真舒心哪~我都有些困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was relaxing. I'm almost sleepy.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？你不是想说中途退场吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, you're not leaving, are you?

Desc.SourceString: 咱们花了钱的，就是不喜欢也得看完，明白了么？
Desc.LocalizedString: We spilled the Fons, so we're finishing the movie. Understood?

Desc.SourceString: 你想多看点细节？我倒是可以帮你调慢播放速度。
Desc.LocalizedString: You want to see more details? I can slow down the movie for you.

Desc.SourceString: 即使猜到了结局……好好见证到最后也是观众的素养呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if you guessed the ending, a good audience should witness the movie till the end.

Desc.SourceString: 雪啊……落得再慢些就好了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Snow… if only it fell slower…

Desc.SourceString: 这个时候就该喝点美酒，暖暖身子才好。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a great time for a drink to warm ourselves up.

Desc.SourceString: 枯冬虽一色，犹有风叶声。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even in a pale winter, leaves still rustle in the wind.

Desc.SourceString: 这雨声淅淅沥沥，呼——听得都有些困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The rain pitter-patters… Ah, I'm getting sleepy.

Desc.SourceString: 雨啊雨啊……阿德勒应该记得收衣服吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Rain, oh rain… Adler should've taken in the clothes, right?

Desc.SourceString: 喜雨落草径，青露自盈盈。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rain lands on the grassy path, dewdrops brimming with azure light.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？看腻这风景了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: What? You bored of this view already?

Desc.SourceString: 招财宝，你说伊波恩要是开在这附近，是不是天天都能赚一大笔？
Desc.LocalizedString: Say, Precious, if Eibon moves here, do you think we'll make a lot of money every day?

Desc.SourceString: 想说什么？我在听。
Desc.LocalizedString: A Fons for your thoughts?

Desc.SourceString: 美景值千金呢~要是真值千金就更好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This view is worth a fortune. If only it could give me a fortune.

Desc.SourceString: 好了，许愿时间结束，要散散步么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright. Wishing time is over. Shall we take a walk?

Desc.SourceString: 祈福讲究一个「心诚则灵」，不灵就不灵了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your heart is all that matters when you make a wish. It won't come true if you're not sincere.

Desc.SourceString: 这福牌看着也没什么区别，一张只许一个愿望……亏了亏了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This plaque isn't that special. One wish for one plaque… not the best deal.

Desc.SourceString: 漫漫长夜里，唯余一缕香。
Desc.LocalizedString: Through the endless night, a wisp of fragrance remains.

Desc.SourceString: 一个祈福牌2000方斯，两个祈福牌4000方斯……伊波恩后院是不是也有棵树？
Desc.LocalizedString: One Wish Plaque for 2,000 Fons, Two plaques for 4,000… Isn't there also a tree in Eibon's backyard?

Desc.SourceString: 福荫木和招财宝，双喜临门，不错不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: Fortune Shades and our Precious. Two auspicious signs. Pretty good.

Desc.SourceString: 要是有杯好酒……啧，这地方竟然不让喝酒。
Desc.LocalizedString: I could use a drink… Tch, alcohol isn't allowed here.

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮，转得好慢。小房间，摇摇晃晃……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ferris wheel, so slow. Small room, shaking…

Desc.SourceString: 在下面看，摩天轮好像能够到云彩。坐到上面，发现天空还是好远……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking from below, Ferris wheel, as tall as clouds. Sitting here, sky still far…

Desc.SourceString: 转动摩天轮的人，是谁？力气很大，安魂曲，很佩服……
Desc.LocalizedString: Who turns Ferris wheel? Very strong. Lacrimosa, impressed…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，快来看。下面的人，比番茄籽还要小。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, look. People below, smaller than tomato seed.

Desc.SourceString: 那里，好像有冰淇淋车……下去之后，想买冰淇淋。
Desc.LocalizedString: There, ice cream cart… Want buy ice cream, when get down.

Desc.SourceString: 大楼的玻璃，都亮亮的。真好。管理局的玻璃不亮，安魂曲才会撞到……
Desc.LocalizedString: Those buildings, shiny glass. BAC glass, not shiny. Lacrimosa, bump into it…

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲平时，只能自己飞。在高处和鉴定师一起，很新鲜。下次，还想一起坐摩天轮……
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, flies alone. With Appraiser this high, is fun. Next time, Ferris wheel again…

Desc.SourceString: 电影院，好黑。安魂曲，困了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Theater, dark. Lacrimosa, sleepy…

Desc.SourceString: 怪兽，好帅。安魂曲，也想像那样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Monster, so cool. Lacrimosa, want be cool too.

Desc.SourceString: 唔，屏幕里的人在哭……安魂曲，想帮忙……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, person in screen, crying… Lacrimosa, want to help…

Desc.SourceString: 电影，真有趣。安魂曲，很开心。谢谢鉴定师，邀请安魂曲……
Desc.LocalizedString: Movie, so fun. Lacrimosa, happy. Thank you, Appraiser, for inviting…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……给安魂曲的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this… for Lacrimosa?

Desc.SourceString: 冰淇淋，凉凉的……喜欢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ice cream… icy… yum.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师吃起来，冰淇淋是什么味道？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, what does ice cream, taste like?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，要快点吃。冰淇淋，要化掉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, eat soon. Ice cream, melting.

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师。下次，安魂曲来请客。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks, Appraiser. Next time, Lacrimosa pay.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……变干净了。谢谢鉴定师
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooh… cleaner now. Thanks, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 加油，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you can do it!

Desc.SourceString: 夹子，晃晃悠悠……
Desc.LocalizedString: Claw, wobble, wobble…

Desc.SourceString: 好可爱。谢谢你，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: So cute. Thank you, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲，会放在房间里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, will keep in room.

Desc.SourceString: 下次，还想一起玩。
Desc.LocalizedString: Next time, play together again.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然都是俯视，这里跟上晴塔的感觉却完全不同。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking down from here feels so different from looking down from the skytower.

Desc.SourceString: 这样的地方总是能让我静下心来。
Desc.LocalizedString: Places like this calm me down.

Desc.SourceString: 你经常来这里吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you come here often?

Desc.SourceString: 我脸上又没有风景，还是看窗外吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: My face isn't a scenic view. Look outside the window.
Hmm…? Anything wrong?

Desc.SourceString: 像是跟世界隔绝了，似乎全世界只有我们两个。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's like we're isolated from the rest of the world. It's just the two of us.

Desc.SourceString: 下次再一起来吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's come here together another time.

Desc.SourceString: 不喜欢这部吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't like this one?

Desc.SourceString: 觉得无聊要不睡会？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanna take a nap if you're bored?

Desc.SourceString: 有些吃的就更好了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wish I had something to munch on…

Desc.SourceString: 今天多谢了，虽然没怎么记住电影的内容……
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks for inviting me today, though I don't really remember what the movie was about…

Desc.SourceString: 这种程度的风，正好。
Desc.LocalizedString: The wind is just about right.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么，想跟我比一比？
Desc.LocalizedString: What? Wanna see who flies higher?

Desc.SourceString: 专心点啊，一会儿风筝飞走了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Focus. The kite might fly away.

Desc.SourceString: 我可不是什么分心了还能战胜的对手。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not someone you can beat when you're distracted.

Desc.SourceString: 挺有干劲的嘛。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're trying hard.

Desc.SourceString: 太用力的话可是会断掉的。
Desc.LocalizedString: The string will break if you pull too hard.

Desc.SourceString: 明明提醒过你了……别在意，下次再试试吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't mind that. You can always try again.

Desc.SourceString: 这种悠哉悠哉的感觉真不错，有机会再一起来吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I like this relaxed pace. Let's do this again.

Desc.SourceString: 有没有什么有趣的东西呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder if there's any fun stuff here…

Desc.SourceString: 夕阳时刻的海滩，很漂亮吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: The beach looks great in the dawn, right?

Desc.SourceString: 没准可以用在沙滩上留下的脚印画个图案出来？
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe we can draw something with our footprints on the sand?

Desc.SourceString: 看来明天会是个好天气。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like tomorrow's gonna be a nice day.

Desc.SourceString: 唔，等鉴定师过来……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, I'm waiting for you here…

Desc.SourceString: 看招！
Desc.LocalizedString: Take this!

Desc.SourceString: 赤龙突袭！
Desc.LocalizedString: Red Dragon attack!

Desc.SourceString: 不但不投降，反而向我还击吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You're fighting back instead of surrendering?

Desc.SourceString: （开心的轻笑）
玩过头了啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: I played around too much…

Desc.SourceString: 让我稍微休息下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me rest for a while.

Desc.SourceString: 我很喜欢这个时间的海边，你呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: I like the beach around this time. What about you?

Desc.SourceString: 城市……真小啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: The city… looks tiny.

Desc.SourceString: 你说这摩天轮是谁发明的？在天上兜兜转转，还挺有意思！
Desc.LocalizedString: Say, how did that Ferris guy invent this wheel? It's so fun spinning in mid-air!

Desc.SourceString: 要不要在这儿待久一点呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should we stay here for a bit longer?

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？窗外的风景，看腻了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You good? Are you bored with the view outside?

Desc.SourceString: 诶……我脸上有东西……吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… Is there something on my… face?

Desc.SourceString: 想看我随时都行啦，但轿厢转过了这个位置，这儿的风景就要错过咯。
Desc.LocalizedString: You can gawk at my face any other time, but you shouldn't miss the view from this angle.

Desc.SourceString: 跟你一起来这儿感觉真好，以后也还想再来啊～
Desc.LocalizedString: It felt great being here with you. I'll come again any time!

Desc.SourceString: 不想看电影的话，去干点别的？
Desc.LocalizedString: We can do something else if you don't want to watch a movie.

Desc.SourceString: 别看我，我也不知道这电影讲的什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't look at me. I don't know what this movie is about either…

Desc.SourceString: 多谢你带我过来啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks for bringing me here!

Desc.SourceString: 下次也来一起看上映的新片吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's watch a new movie next time!

Desc.SourceString: 不知道它会漂到哪里呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder where the waves will take it?

Desc.SourceString: 加油，只要能躲过所有海浪，你就能到对岸咯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't give up! You'll come ashore after riding all the waves!

Desc.SourceString: 就算是纸做的船，也要有征服风浪的梦想！
Desc.LocalizedString: Although you're made of paper, you should still aim to conquer the seas!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，要来试着折只小船吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you want to fold a paper boat with me?

Desc.SourceString: 放纸船什么的，果然很奇怪吧……不过这儿也没有外人，无所谓了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Playing with paper boats… is strange, right? But since there are no outsiders here, I don't care!

Desc.SourceString: 听说在有的地方，往水里放漂浮物是一种祈福仪式来着。不过具体的我也不太清楚……
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard in some places, they place objects to float away in search of blessings. I'm not sure how it works though…

Desc.SourceString: 没想到你居然愿意陪我做这么，呃，幼稚的事……之后你有什么需要帮忙的，随时来找我吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't expect you to do something this… childish with me. You know, come to me whenever you need help!

Desc.SourceString: 我可是钓鱼高手，看我给你钓上来条大的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm a fishing expert. Let me show you how to catch a big one!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么还不上钩呢～怎么还不上钩呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where are the fish? Why won't they bite already…?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你那边「战况」怎么样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, how's it going for you? Any spoils?

Desc.SourceString: 我就说能钓上来大鱼的吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: I told you I could catch a big one!

Desc.SourceString: 咱们今天可以加餐咯！
Desc.LocalizedString: We got a big fish for dinner!

Desc.SourceString: 不错不错，至少不是空手了～
Desc.LocalizedString: Not bad. At least it's something!

Desc.SourceString: 没想到，海特洛也有这个品种的鱼啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't know you could catch this kind of fish in Hethereau.

Desc.SourceString: 这个呢，是「废弃鱼」！由海里的垃圾转化而成，不可食用！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is known as the "Garbage Fish," formed from trash in the sea. It's not edible!

Desc.SourceString: 咳，别看它这个样子，这其实是一种非常稀有的海鱼！它的名字是……「窝兹基曲德鱼」！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem, it may look ugly, but it's extremely rare! Marine biologists call it the Totallynotmadeup Fishicus!

Desc.SourceString: 跟你一起钓鱼，比自己一个人有意思多了！有空再来一起吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a lot more fun fishing with you than fishing alone! Let's do this again!

Desc.SourceString: 升到半空中了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're in mid-air.

Desc.SourceString: 我们的轿厢不会突然掉下去，砸到地上吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Our cabin won't suddenly fall down and splatter, would it?

Desc.SourceString: 原来，我们生活在这样的城市里呀~
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, so this is the city we live in.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么啦，外面的风景不好看吗~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? Is the view out there not good enough?

Desc.SourceString: 怎么啦，觉得我好看吗？那多看一会儿也没关系哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: So, you prefer to look at me? I don't mind if you look at me longer!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师是想和我一起跳下去吗？诶，不是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you thinking of leaping down with me? Oh, you're not?

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师带我来。我自己一个人可不敢上去呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, thanks for bringing me here. I wouldn't have went up there by myself…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？我可不是电影的一部分哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? I'm not quite the star of the movie!

Desc.SourceString: 这部电影很没劲吗？原来是这样啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: So this movie is actually mid? I see…

Desc.SourceString: 电影好像还没结束呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't think the movie is over yet.

Desc.SourceString: 看电影的感觉很好，谢谢鉴定师~
Desc.LocalizedString: I liked the movie a lot. Thanks, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 不管是什么蛋糕，我都喜欢的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I like all kinds of cakes!

Desc.SourceString: 要是在上面满满当当地铺满草莓，会不会很漂亮呢~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wouldn't the cake be pretty if it had strawberries all over it?

Desc.SourceString: 要加在这里吗~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should I put more here?

Desc.SourceString: 再多加一点吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's add more!

Desc.SourceString: 加上去的东西，鉴定师要全部吃掉哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you gotta eat up all the extra toppings!

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢鉴定师带我来做蛋糕，很有趣呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, thanks for bringing me here to bake a cake. It was fun!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，很温暖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you're warm.

Desc.SourceString: 我们会飘到世界的另一头去吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Will we float to the other side of the world?

Desc.SourceString: 云朵软绵绵的，就像小绵羊一样呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: The cloud is soft, just like a little lamb!

Desc.SourceString: 放心，我不会乱动，也不会掉下去的~
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I won't fidget around and I won't fall down!

Desc.SourceString: 我的脸有变形吗？好像躺下的时候，脸颊的肉会垂下去呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is my face weird? I think my cheeks sag a little when I lie on my side…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师一直看着我……不是因为恐高吧~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you keep looking at me… You're not scared of heights, are you?

Desc.SourceString: ……没有味道呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Doesn't taste like anything.

Desc.SourceString: 要尝尝看吗？这东西完~全没有味道哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanna try? This thing has absolutely no flavor!

Desc.SourceString: 和鉴定师待在一起很开心！下次还想再来~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I had a good time with you. Let's come again!

Desc.SourceString: 要是摩天轮的转速提高一百倍……是不是就可以用来训练宇航员了？
Desc.LocalizedString: If the Ferris wheel spun a hundred times faster… could it be used in astronaut training?

Desc.SourceString: 以前我一个人坐摩天轮的时候，当滑过顶点、高度开始下降，我就会有点难过……
Desc.LocalizedString: When I used to ride the Ferris wheel alone, I always felt a little sad the moment it passed the top and started going down…

Desc.SourceString: 某种程度上，我们脚下的星球，也像是摩天轮的一个轿厢，永恒地围绕着太阳旋转……
Desc.LocalizedString: In a way, the planet beneath our feet is like a Ferris wheel cabin, circling around the sun forever…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？鉴定师的电波好像变得更强烈了，是因为在密闭空间内吗？还是因为别的原因……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? Appraiser, your frequency just got stronger. Is it because we're in a confined space? Or is there another reason…?

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼哼哼~嗯？这个旋律……灵可也不知道叫什么，只是在电波里听见过……鉴定师喜欢吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lalala… Hmm, this melody… I don't know what it's called, but I heard it before… Appraiser, you like it?

Desc.SourceString: 如果离地面足够远，会有一种……我们在同一个飞船逃生舱的感觉？噢！突然感觉好浪漫……
Desc.LocalizedString: If we were far enough from the ground, I'd feel like… we're in the same escape pod on a spaceship. Oh! This suddenly feels so romantic…

Desc.SourceString: 感觉……和鉴定师在一起的时候，摩天轮好像转得比平常要快呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, it feels like… when I'm with you, the Ferris wheel spins faster than usual.

Desc.SourceString: 唔姆……真是个奇怪的现象。我们下次再来研究一下是怎么回事吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmmm... this is such a strange phenomenon. Let's come back to figure it out next time!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……感受到了鉴定师强烈的视线！难道鉴定师也想吐槽刚刚的剧情？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mmm… I can feel your intense gaze! Don't tell me, you want to diss that movie too?

Desc.SourceString: 直觉告诉我，马上会有一个超大的转折……比如这一切只是主角的一个梦！之类的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I have a feeling that there's gonna be a huge plot twist… like this whole thing's just the protag's dream, or something like that!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师想说悄悄话吗……感觉比起单纯看电影，一边看一边互相说悄悄话会更有意思！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you wanna whisper…? Instead of just watching the film, watching while whispering is more exciting!

Desc.SourceString: 唔姆……有点不记得电影讲了什么了，只记得时不时会接收到鉴定师的电波……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my… I don't remember what the movie was about. I just knew that I was detecting your signals from time to time…

Desc.SourceString: 要不，下次再一起看看？好作品就是要多刷几遍嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't we come watch it again? Good films deserve to be watched more!

Desc.SourceString: 在接触判定的零点五秒内转一圈摇杆——就能实现那个传说中的高阶操作技巧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Rotate the joystick a full circle within half a second of contact—and you can pull off that legendary…

Desc.SourceString: 街机厅要是多进一些游戏就好了，感觉这个已经快玩腻了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope the arcade center had more games. I'm getting bored of the ones it has…

Desc.SourceString: 唔姆……等下就用这招吓鉴定师一跳！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ummm… I'll use that move to give the Appraiser a surprise!

Desc.SourceString: 终于来临了，与鉴定师的宿命对决——真遗憾，年轻的挑战者，你的登顶之路就到此为止了！
Desc.LocalizedString: At last, the fated showdown with the Appraiser has arrived. Alas, young challenger, your climb to the top ends here!

Desc.SourceString: 唔……刚刚一不小心进入「心流领域」了，看来我宝刀未老嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oops… I just entered the flow state. Seems like I haven't lost my skills!

Desc.SourceString: ……不对，要是赢得慢一些，就能多和鉴定师玩一会儿了！真是失策……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait… if I didn't win so fast, I'd still be playing with the Appraiser! What a mistake…

Desc.SourceString: 唔姆~实力不俗嘛，那下次，灵可就用右手和鉴定师来玩了哦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, you're not bad. Next time, I'll play against you with my right hand…

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼……开玩笑的啦，游戏就应该全力以赴，灵可是不会放水的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh… I'm just joking! You have to give it all when you play games. I won't take it easy on you!

Desc.SourceString: 时间过得好快，本来还想和鉴定师一起打僵尸或者玩格斗游戏……下次，再和灵可一起玩吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Time went by fast. I still wanted to kill some zombies or play a fighting game… Let's play again next time then!

Desc.SourceString: 夜空中的每颗星星，彼此之间都离得很远很远……这么一想，有一点寂寞。
Desc.LocalizedString: Every star in the night sky is so, so far apart… when you think about it that way, it can feel a bit lonely.

Desc.SourceString: 宇宙在向我们歌唱……我们的心跳，也在为它打着节拍。
Desc.LocalizedString: The universe is singing to us… and our heartbeats are keeping the rhythm.

Desc.SourceString: 如果，我们能找到一个还没被发现的星座，就用我们的名字给它命名吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: If we ever find a constellation no one's discovered yet, let's name it after us.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，鉴定师的电波，我接收到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mm, I have detected your frequency.

Desc.SourceString: 现在就好像……整个宇宙里，只剩下鉴定师在我的身边。
Desc.LocalizedString: It feels like… the entire universe is just you and me.

Desc.SourceString: 如果一直都是这样的夜晚就好了……
Desc.LocalizedString: If only every night were like this…

Desc.SourceString: 哔啵哔啵……嗯（笑），鉴定师的眼睛，现在亮晶晶的，很漂亮。
Desc.LocalizedString: Beep-boop, beep-boop… Heheh, Appraiser, your eyes are sparkling. They look pretty.

Desc.SourceString: 突然感觉，世界离我们好远……还好，我们离得很近。
Desc.LocalizedString: I suddenly feel like the world is far away from us… At least we're close to each other.

Desc.SourceString: 那颗星星的亮光，也许来自几万年以前……它现在是什么样子呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: The light from that star might be from tens of thousands of years ago… what does it look like now?

Desc.SourceString: 啊，那颗星星好像在动 ！难道是伪装成星星的飞船——噢，是流星啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, that star looks like it's moving! Could it actually be a spaceship? Ohhh—it's a shooting star.

Desc.SourceString: 今天的星星好漂亮，就好像特意在等待我们一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: The stars tonight are so pretty! It's like they were waiting for us.

Desc.SourceString: 这里就是全海特洛的最佳观测点！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is the best spot to stargaze in Hethereau!

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢你带我来这里，鉴定师，我会记住这一天的，会记很久很久。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, thank you for bringing me here. I'll remember this day for a long, long time.

Desc.SourceString: 远处的世界原来是这般模样……
Desc.LocalizedString: So this is what the world looks like from far away…

Desc.SourceString: 我喜欢离天空很近的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: I like places that are closer to the sky.

Desc.SourceString: 命运之轮也是这样不歇地转动吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this how the wheel of fortune spins…?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师……走神了吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… still there?
…Huh?

Desc.SourceString: 天的尽头有颗星星，一闪，一闪……
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a shimmering star at the far reaches of the sky…

Desc.SourceString: 今天很开心……下次还想和鉴定师一起……当然，做什么都可以……
Desc.LocalizedString: I had a great time today… I want to do things with you again… Anything will do…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师在想什么呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, what's on your mind?

Desc.SourceString: 错过的剧情我会讲给你听的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I can tell you about the plot you missed.

Desc.SourceString: 再发呆电影就结束了哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: The movie's going to end if you stare any longer.

Desc.SourceString: 感谢你的邀请，鉴定师，这部电影……我很喜欢……
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks for inviting me, Appraiser. I liked… the movie…

Desc.SourceString: 这个速度……好快……！
Desc.LocalizedString: This speed… so fast…!

Desc.SourceString: 在地下飞行的机会可不多呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't get to fly underground every day.

Desc.SourceString: 像鸟儿一样穿梭。
Desc.LocalizedString: As fast as a bird.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师……还好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… are you okay?

Desc.SourceString: 感到害怕的话，可以靠近我一点……
Desc.LocalizedString: If you're scared, you can get closer to me…

Desc.SourceString: 要拐弯咯~
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a turn!

Desc.SourceString: 呼……要不要去体验一下更刺激的项目呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whew… should we go play something more exciting?

Desc.SourceString: 还可以再高一点。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't mind going higher.

Desc.SourceString: 大地之上，星辰之下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Above the earth, below the stars.

Desc.SourceString: 从这里好像能看到魔女之家……？
Desc.LocalizedString: I think I can see the Witch's House from here…?

Desc.SourceString: 做一只鸟儿的感觉怎么样，鉴定师？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, how's it like feeling like a bird?

Desc.SourceString: 我们闭上眼睛，让它带着我们飘荡吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's close our eyes and drift with the balloon.

Desc.SourceString: 我想再多待一会儿……可以吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I want to stay here a bit longer… Can I?

Desc.SourceString: 如果热气球可以飞到星星上……鉴定师，下次要试一试吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, if a hot air balloon could fly as high as the stars… will you give it a try?

Desc.SourceString: 怎么啦，有什么悄悄话想讲给我听吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: So, do you have a secret to share with me?

Desc.SourceString: 无聊的话，我们快进一下？开玩笑的~
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want me to fast-forward the movie? Just kidding…!

Desc.SourceString: 要不要来猜猜接下来的剧情走向？
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's guess what's gonna happen next!

Desc.SourceString: 原来鉴定师喜欢的电影是这样啊~感觉更了解你了呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: So that is the kind of movie you like. I think I know you a little better!

Desc.SourceString: 下面这些来来往往的人里，会有多少我的朋友呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: How many of the people down there are friends of mine?

Desc.SourceString: 叮咚~亲爱的乘客，我们的包厢即将进入云层！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ding-dong! Dear guest, our cabin is about to enter the clouds!

Desc.SourceString: 如果就这样一直上升，直到信号无法抵达的高度……嗯，会怎样呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What happens if we just keep going up and up, until the signal is out of range? Hmm…

Desc.SourceString: 如果害怕的话，可以握住我的手。
Desc.LocalizedString: You can hold my hand if you're scared.

Desc.SourceString: 要不要一起拍张合照？就用整座城市的天际线当背景吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanna take a pic together? We'll use the city skyline as the backdrop!

Desc.SourceString: 真可惜，摩天轮总会转回地面……不过，就算从这个小房间走出去，外面的世界也一样很有趣吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's sad how the wheel always comes back… But hey, even when you step out of the cabin, the world is just as fun, isn't it?

Desc.SourceString: 美好的时光总是结束得很快……不过，我们随时都可以让它重新开始哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Great times always fly by… but we can always start another round!

Desc.SourceString: 这个角度很不错哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice angle!

Desc.SourceString: 之后要发到呗果上~
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll post this on Bagel!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，看这边——茄~子！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, over here! Say chee—eese!

Desc.SourceString: 等下烟花升空的时候，这里应该能看得很清楚吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: This should be a good spot to see the fireworks, right?

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿，好期待啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, I'm so stoked!

Desc.SourceString: 烟火秀什么时候开始呢？得快点找到视野好的位置。
Desc.LocalizedString: When do the fireworks begin? Gotta find a place with a good view.

Desc.SourceString: 就像星星化作雨点落下来一样呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's like the stars are raining down.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师喜欢什么颜色的烟花呢？我们一起找找看~
Desc.LocalizedString: What's your favorite fireworks color? Let's look for it!

Desc.SourceString: 今天我们一起看过的烟花，有没有好好留在你的记忆中呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: The fireworks we watched today… Have you etched them into your mind?

Desc.SourceString: 任水流推着飘飘荡荡，会前往哪个方向呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Little boat drifting light, on the water shining bright!

Desc.SourceString: 你好啊，小鱼~你也和朋友一起出来玩吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Henlo, fishy! Are you out here with frens?

Desc.SourceString: 和畅游数据之海的感觉有些不同呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: This is quite different from cruising through the sea of data, huh?

Desc.SourceString: 倒映在水中的我……与你眼中的我，会不会有什么不同呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: When I'm reflected in the water and when I'm in your eyes… is there any difference?

Desc.SourceString: 要是能这样一直漂流下去，我们会不会抵达大海呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Will we reach the ocean if we keep drifting?

Desc.SourceString: 我也想试试划桨！我们一人一支桨的话，船应该能稳稳地前进吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I wanna try rowing! The boat should go smoothly if we each grab an oar?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯——乘船真惬意啊！下次我们再一起玩吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm! That was fun! Let's do it again!

Desc.SourceString: 场景和监控画面里的相比有色差。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a color difference between this view and the surveillance feed.

Desc.SourceString: 信号变弱了一点……
Desc.LocalizedString: The signal got weaker…

Desc.SourceString: 类似于，看城市中各类数据的总览图。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is like a dashboard of the city's data.

Desc.SourceString: ……？我不恐高。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm…? I'm not afraid of heights.

Desc.SourceString: 发现什么漏洞了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you notice any loopholes?

Desc.SourceString: ……你卡了吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: …You stuck there?

Desc.SourceString: 比想象中坐得久。
Desc.LocalizedString: Took longer than I expected.

Desc.SourceString: 一轮循环的时长是固定的么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does each cycle take the same time?

Desc.SourceString: 看不下去的话提前终止这个进程也可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: We can terminate this process if you're done.

Desc.SourceString: 目前没发现有趣的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing of interest so far.

Desc.SourceString: 这一作在网上的风评是……算了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bagel thinks this movie is… never mind.

Desc.SourceString: 监视呗果的时候读过剧透帖了，没有意外感。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nothing surprised me. I saw spoilers when surveilling Bagel.

Desc.SourceString: 是这电影不对你胃口么？
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't like this movie?

Desc.SourceString: 专心看电影，盯着我看干嘛。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are you looking at me? Keep your eyes on the screen.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？难道我比这电影还好看？
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, do you think I'm more interesting than the movie?

Desc.SourceString: 不错的电影，值回票价。下次再一起来看吧，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: The movie was worth the Fons. Let's come back again.

Desc.SourceString: 速度再快一些会不会更刺激？哈哈，别紧张，我开玩笑的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Wouldn't it be even more exciting if we went a little faster? Haha, relax, relax—I'm just joking.

Desc.SourceString: 之前还从没有和别人一起坐过摩天轮。感觉还挺不错的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've never been on a Ferris wheel with anyone else before. It's not so bad, actually.

Desc.SourceString: 安安静静地坐在这里，远离都市里的喧嚣。难得的放松时刻啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Just sitting here, nice and quiet, far from all the city noise. What a rare moment to just relax…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了，难道是恐高了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's wrong? Don't tell me you're afraid of heights.

Desc.SourceString: 从这个角度看……能看到什么不一样的地方吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: From this angle… do you notice anything different?

Desc.SourceString: 氛围不错，要拍张照吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a nice vibe here. Want to take a photo?

Desc.SourceString: 看看远处的风景，还挺放松的。下次再一起来吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: The view from here is really breathtaking. Let's come here together again next time, okay?

Desc.SourceString: 我喜欢这种悠闲的放松方式，记得下次再约我来啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: I really like unwinding like this. Don't forget to invite me again next time, okay?

Desc.SourceString: 这个位置不错，准备开始录制咯。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a good angle. Get ready to record.

Desc.SourceString: 约你出来录制MV，应该没有麻烦到你吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Not bothering you with this music video, am I?

Desc.SourceString: 熙熙攘攘的街道，来来往往的人们……
Desc.LocalizedString: Bustling streets, people coming and going…

Desc.SourceString: 城市的夜景，闪烁的霓虹灯……真漂亮。
Desc.LocalizedString: The city at night, flickering neon lights… so pretty.

Desc.SourceString: 和我的鼓手一起感受城市的脉搏……我会把它写进下次的歌词里的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Feeling the city's pulse with my drummer… I'll write this into my next song.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？感到累了吗？休息一会吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, you tired? Let's take a break.

Desc.SourceString: 这里可看不到什么星星，下次去郊外试试吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: No stars to gaze at here. Let's go to the outskirts of town next time.

Desc.SourceString: 一直盯着我看……难道和镜头下的我有什么不一样的地方吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You keep staring… am I different from how I look on screen?

Desc.SourceString: 看你也跃跃欲试的样子，下次换我来给你拍吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: You look like you want to give it a go. I can record you next time. How about that?

Desc.SourceString: 你之前应该没有尝试过拍MV吧？还挺有趣的，对吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: You haven't made a music video before, have you? Isn't it fun?

Desc.SourceString: 等下次应该就是「猫头音！！！！」全员出席了吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Next time, all members of The Whoots!!!! will be present!

Desc.SourceString: 稍微有点累了……拍摄还真是个体力活，今天就早点回去休息吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm a bit tired… Shooting a video is a lot of work. Go home early and get some rest.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……感觉……被当成小孩子了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oof… I feel like… I'm being treated like a kid…

Desc.SourceString: 这是为了陪你，我一个人可不坐这个。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm only doing this for you. Otherwise I'd never sit on this.

Desc.SourceString: 真是悠闲啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: How chill.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？是想和我换位置？感觉每个都差不多吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: What? Wanna swap seats? Does it make a difference?

Desc.SourceString: 别太崇拜你的主唱大人，小心看得出神，摔下去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you adore your lead singer too much, you might get distracted and fall off your horse.

Desc.SourceString: 我的头发……是被吹乱了吗？等会儿理一理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Is my hair messed up…? Must have been the wind.

Desc.SourceString: 哈，你骑上去还挺拉风的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hah, you know, you actually look pretty cool.

Desc.SourceString: 你也乐在其中啊，那就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're having fun. That's good.

Desc.SourceString: 说起来……童话里骑白马的一般都是主角吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: They say… the prince or princess usually rides a white horse.

Desc.SourceString: 下次还会再来吗？还……还挺有趣的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Will we come here again? It was… fun.

Desc.SourceString: 没有偏好，点什么都可以。
Desc.LocalizedString: Whatever. I don't have preferences.

Desc.SourceString: 权限接管，我来处理这个。
Desc.LocalizedString: Taking over. Let me handle this.

Desc.SourceString: 3、2、1……拆掉了，继续推进。
Desc.LocalizedString: 3, 2, 1... Dismantled. Moving on.

Desc.SourceString: 会被喝掉，不明白意义。
Desc.LocalizedString: Meaning? It's going to get chugged soon.

Desc.SourceString: 苦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bitter.

Desc.SourceString: 有什么问题吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is anything wrong?

Desc.SourceString: 到家为止，会通过监控目送的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll see you off through the cameras till you get home.

Desc.SourceString: 有紧急工作，离开一趟。
Desc.LocalizedString: Urgent task. I'm heading off.

Desc.SourceString: 预估用时不确定。
Desc.LocalizedString: Estimated time, uncertain.

Desc.SourceString: 有急事？
Desc.LocalizedString: Urgent request?

Desc.SourceString: 不用，我带了这个。
Desc.LocalizedString: No need. I brought this.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，效率比较高。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, it's more efficient.
…Fine.

Desc.SourceString: 味道不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not bad.

Desc.SourceString: 尝了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I have.

Desc.SourceString: 已经够了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I had enough.

Desc.SourceString: 亏损了效率，但偶尔一次影响不大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Efficiency lowered, but it's fine once in a while.

Desc.SourceString: 这顿我来支付。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll pay for the food.

Desc.SourceString: 刚、刚才那是什么……？！我一定是在做梦……
Desc.LocalizedString: W-What was that…? I must be trippin'…

Desc.SourceString: Exe有什么想喝的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Anything you want to drink?

Desc.SourceString: Exe有什么想喝的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Anything you want to drink?

Desc.SourceString: 这个拉花做得挺好看的，你觉不觉得？
Desc.LocalizedString: The latte art came out nice, don't you think?

Desc.SourceString: 这个拉花做得挺好看的，你觉不觉得？
Desc.LocalizedString: The latte art came out nice, don't you think?

Desc.SourceString: 咖啡的味道如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: How was the coffee?

Desc.SourceString: 咖啡的味道如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: How was the coffee?

Desc.SourceString: 我们好像有一会没说话了……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Has it been a while since we talked…?

Desc.SourceString: 我们好像有一会没说话了……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Has it been a while since we talked…?

Desc.SourceString: 时间不早了，我先回去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a bit late. I should head back.

Desc.SourceString: 时间不早了，我先回去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a bit late. I should head back.

Desc.SourceString: 不确定就是没了吗，这家伙，下次一定要宰他一顿……
Desc.LocalizedString: He left because he's unsure how long it'll take. I'm gonna make him pay for something…

Desc.SourceString: 不确定就是没了吗，这家伙，下次一定要宰他一顿……
Desc.LocalizedString: He left because he's unsure how long it'll take. I'm gonna make him pay for something…

Desc.SourceString: 也没有很着急啦，就是想着难得碰上你有空，请你吃顿饭。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not that urgent. I just thought I'd buy you a meal since you have time.

Desc.SourceString: 也没有很着急啦，就是想着难得碰上你有空，请你吃顿饭。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not that urgent. I just thought I'd buy you a meal since you have time.

Desc.SourceString: ……饭团？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Onigiri?

Desc.SourceString: ……饭团？
Desc.LocalizedString: …Onigiri?

Desc.SourceString: ……等一下，今天不准用这个随便解决。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Wait, you're not eating this today.

Desc.SourceString: ……等一下，今天不准用这个随便解决。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Wait, you're not eating this today.

Desc.SourceString: 既然都已经来了，今天就好好放松一下，就算是机器，也需要充电的时间吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: You're already here, so kick back and relax. Even machines need time to recharge, right?

Desc.SourceString: 既然都已经来了，今天就好好放松一下，就算是机器，也需要充电的时间吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: You're already here, so kick back and relax. Even machines need time to recharge, right?

Desc.SourceString: 这个、这个、还有这个……嗯，这个也来一份！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have this, this, and this… Hmm, and that too!

Desc.SourceString: 这个、这个、还有这个……嗯，这个也来一份！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have this, this, and this… Hmm, and that too!

Desc.SourceString: 好了，今天你什么都不用管，负责好好吃饭就行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, all you need to do is have a good meal today.

Desc.SourceString: 好了，今天你什么都不用管，负责好好吃饭就行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, all you need to do is have a good meal today.

Desc.SourceString: 这个也不错，你尝尝。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is good. Give it a try.

Desc.SourceString: 这个也不错，你尝尝。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is good. Give it a try.

Desc.SourceString: 还有这个！
Desc.LocalizedString: And this!

Desc.SourceString: 还有这个！
Desc.LocalizedString: And this!

Desc.SourceString: 吃得好饱……怎么样，今天这顿不错吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: That was a lot of food… It was a good meal, no?

Desc.SourceString: 吃得好饱……怎么样，今天这顿不错吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: That was a lot of food… It was a good meal, no?

Desc.SourceString: （这就是Exe的表达方式吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This must be how he shows appreciation…)
